Constructor Detail

MetaABMFunctionPackageImpl

private MetaABMFunctionPackageImpl()
Creates an instance of the model Package, registered with EPackage.Registry by the package package URI value.

Note: the correct way to create the package is via the static factory method init(), which also performs initialization of the package, or returns the registered package, if one already exists.

See Also:
org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EPackage.Registry, MetaABMFunctionPackage.eNS_URI, init()
Method Detail

init

public static MetaABMFunctionPackage init()
Creates, registers, and initializes the Package for this model, and for any others upon which it depends.

This method is used to initialize MetaABMFunctionPackage.eINSTANCE when that field is accessed. Clients should not invoke it directly. Instead, they should simply access that field to obtain the package.

See Also:
MetaABMFunctionPackage.eNS_URI
